summary: Lists the requirements for the Path Computation Element Communication Protocol when paths cross Autonomous System boundaries in MPLS and GMPLS traffic engineering. It builds on the generic PCE requirements. This is an informational document.

eli5.summary: Planning a trip that crosses several countries needs a map-helper that can talk across borders. This memo lists what that helper protocol must be able to do between different networks.

questions: pce communication protocol across autonomous systems
